enchantments.tooltip: Negative Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming negative energy healing by +53 (Profane bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Light Resistance +50: Passive: +50 Enhancement bonus to your Light Resistance.
Quality Intelligence +3: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Intelligence.

Greater Boon of Undeath: Undead take solace in the hate of others. Every time a character wearing a Boon of Undeath item is struck in combat, an Inflict Moderate Wounds spell will be cast on the character.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
